title: European Portuguese: A1 → B1
goal: Reach European Portuguese B1 in about 15 months at 5–6 hours a week.

pronunciation.sound: s / z at end of a syllable

stages.name: Survival
stages.summary: Order anywhere, give directions to the house, book appointments, chat about family for 10 minutes.

blocks.name: Hello & me
blocks.grammar: Subject pronouns (eu, tu, ele/ela, você, nós, eles); ser (sou, é, somos, são); questions with intonation
blocks.vocab: Greetings, please/thank you, numbers 0–20, family (mãe, pai, filha, companheiro)
blocks.task: Introduce yourself to the babysitter and a neighbour

days.focus: Greetings and the sounds of Portugal

tasks.text: Play each greeting, then say it out loud 3 times. Note: bom dia until lunch, boa tarde until dark, boa noite after.
Polite words. Women say obrigada, men say obrigado.
Plan tab → Pronunciation: play every example in the 'Nasal vowels' and 'ão' rows and copy them.
Flashcards: one session on the Everyday topic.
Learn the intro phrases. In Portugal the pronoun goes after the verb: chamo-me, not me chamo.
Write your own 4-line intro: name, where you're from, where you live, 'muito prazer'.
Record yourself reading it on your phone. Play the app's version of each line and compare.
Flashcards: one session (due cards + new ones).
Learn ser in the present. Play and repeat each form.
Tu is for friends, family and kids. With a neighbour you don't know, skip the pronoun or use o senhor / a senhora.
Write 6 sentences with ser about people you know (e.g. 'A Maria é muito simpática'). Read each aloud.
Flashcards: one session.
Play and repeat 0–10. One and two change with gender: um/uma, dois/duas.
Play and repeat 11–20.
Say your phone number digit by digit, then ages: 'Tenho … anos'.
say: Qual é o seu número de telefone?

tasks.text: Flashcards: one session.
Family words. Play and repeat.
Introduce your family.
say: Esta é a minha filha, a Maria

tasks.text: Questions use the same words as statements; only the voice goes up. Play both and hear the difference.
Flashcards: one session.

days.focus: Real life: the babysitter and a neighbour

tasks.text: Write a short script for meeting the babysitter or a neighbour, using days 1–5.
say: Esta é a minha filha, a Maria

tasks.text: Rehearse the script aloud 3 times, with Slow audio on and then off.
Do it for real: say at least the first two lines to a neighbour, shopkeeper or the babysitter.
Flashcards: clear every due card.
Record your full intro again and compare it with Day 2's recording.
Redo any task from this week you skipped or found hard.
Open the Study log and look at your week: aim for about 5 hours.

blocks.name: Café & market
blocks.grammar: querer + queria (polite "I'd like"); articles o/a/os/as, um/uma; gender & plural
blocks.vocab: Café drinks, fruit & veg, quantities (meio quilo, um quilo), numbers to 100, prices
blocks.task: Order coffee and buy fruit in Portuguese every time

blocks.name: Where things are
blocks.grammar: estar (location, temporary states); em/no/na, ao lado de, em frente a; imperative for directions (vire, siga)
blocks.vocab: Directions, house words, colours, street words (rua, rotunda, portão)
blocks.task: Write and learn your 'directions to the house' script; use it with a courier

blocks.name: My day
blocks.grammar: Regular present -ar / -er / -ir (falar, comer, abrir); ter, ir, fazer
blocks.vocab: Days, times (às dez, de manhã), daily routine verbs, school words
blocks.task: Ask the teacher what Maria needs to bring

blocks.name: Booking things
blocks.grammar: poder (pode …?); preciso de; question words (quando, onde, quanto, porquê)
blocks.vocab: Months, dates, appointments (marcar, consulta, limpeza), body basics
blocks.task: Book a dentist appointment in Portuguese (appointment itself in English)

blocks.name: Parcels & fish
blocks.vocab: Post office, parcels, fish counter (limpar, postas, espinhas), "Mais alguma coisa?"
blocks.task: Collect a parcel; buy fish and ask them to clean it

milestones: 10-minute tutor conversation about family and your day, no English
Order, shop at the market and give directions without switching to English
Book one appointment by phone or message in Portuguese

stages.name: Everyday life
stages.summary: Talk about the past, handle check-in and symptoms at the doctor, understand courier and marketing calls, sit CIPLE.

blocks.name: What happened
blocks.grammar: Pretérito perfeito (falei, comi, fui, fiz, tive)
blocks.vocab: Time words (ontem, no fim de semana, há dois dias), weekend activities
blocks.task: Tell the tutor about last weekend; ask the teacher how the day went

blocks.name: How things were
blocks.grammar: Imperfeito (falava, era, tinha) vs perfeito; costumava
blocks.vocab: Childhood, describing places and people, weather
blocks.task: Describe your childhood and where you grew up

blocks.name: Swim & play
blocks.grammar: Imperatives for instructions (bate, sopra, salta, segura); estar a + infinitive
blocks.vocab: Swim class words, body parts, kids' activities, praise
blocks.task: Understand the swim instructor's feedback without asking twice

blocks.name: Doctor stage 2
blocks.grammar: Reflexive verbs (sentir-se, magoar-se); object pronouns (o, a, lhe) and position; doer (dói-me)
blocks.vocab: Symptoms (febre, tosse, dor de …), pharmacy, número de utente
blocks.task: Check in at reception and explain symptoms in Portuguese

blocks.name: Phone & admin
blocks.grammar: Near future ir + infinitive; polite forms (podia, queria); comparisons (mais … do que)
blocks.vocab: Phone openers (Estou a ligar da parte de …), deliveries, bills, school letters
blocks.task: Handle a courier or marketing call start to finish

milestones: Follow a learner podcast (A2) with no transcript
Write a short message to the school or a business

stages.name: Independent
stages.summary: A whole doctor or dentist appointment in Portuguese, follow the news, give opinions, sit DEPLE.

blocks.name: Plans & wishes
blocks.task: Plan a trip with a local in Portuguese

blocks.name: Hopes & doubts
blocks.grammar: Present subjunctive after espero que, quero que, é importante que, talvez
blocks.task: Ask the teacher for feedback and what to work on at home

blocks.name: Doctor stage 3
blocks.grammar: Future subjunctive after quando / se (quando puder, se tiver)
blocks.vocab: Medicines, dosage (de oito em oito horas), tests (análises), referrals
blocks.task: Whole GP or dentist appointment in Portuguese; repeat the advice back

blocks.name: Opinions
blocks.grammar: Connectors (no entanto, por isso, além disso, ou seja, embora + subjunctive); por vs para
blocks.task: Give and defend an opinion for 5 minutes with the tutor

blocks.name: The Portuguese bit
blocks.grammar: Personal infinitive (para fazermos, antes de saíres); past perfect (tinha feito)
blocks.task: Follow an RTP news item and summarise it

blocks.name: Writing
blocks.task: Write a 150-word formal email and an opinion piece

milestones: Top 2,500 words, then add words only from what you read and hear
Read a short novel or graded reader in Portuguese

situations.name: Cafés & ordering
situations.A2: Ask about ingredients, make small talk
situations.B1: Chat with the staff you see regularly

situations.name: Greengrocer & fish counter
situations.A2: Ask them to clean or cut the fish; understand their questions
situations.B1: Ask for cooking advice and what's in season

situations.name: Phone calls
situations.A1: "Pode falar mais devagar?" / "Pode mandar uma mensagem?"
situations.A2: Understand who's calling and why; say no politely

situations.name: Post office & parcels
situations.A1: Pick up with the code; send a parcel
situations.B1: Sort out a lost or damaged parcel

situations.name: School teacher
situations.A2: Ask how Maria is getting on; understand the answer
situations.B1: Discuss progress and concerns in detail

situations.name: Doctor & dentist
situations.A1: Book in Portuguese; appointment in English
situations.A2: Check in and explain symptoms in Portuguese

routine.what: Tutor lesson on your life and the current block's task
Check the week's hours; pick next week's real-life task
